ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_BagUpgrade:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: Larger Pack
<color="grey">Improves your bags capacity by 2.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_Beta:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: The Beta. +15% Reach.
<color="grey">A deep maintenance instructional training video produced by the SRA. Very informative.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_Carabiner:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket:</color> A Carabiner. Placed pitons are more firmly set.
<u>While holding onto a placed piton:</u> Reduced stamina drain, Increased jump height.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_Chalk:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: Chalk. -20% Stamina Drain
<color="grey">It's a good thing you managed to hold onto this.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_EmployeeID:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: An employee ID. Should keep you safe from most security systems.
<color="grey">Stained with the blood of the poor soul who held it.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_Headlamp:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: Headlamp
<color="grey">A low quality flashlight, no crank required.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_MassDamper:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: A carved amulet. Slows all <color="red">Mass</color> forms by 15%.
<color="grey">The thing bubbling up behind you - It hungers, more than you can ever know. Don't let it devour.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_MoonRock:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: A vial of "Moon Rocks". -10% Gravity
<color="grey">The ITAA wanted it all. In the name of science, but moreso in the name of profit.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_Nugget:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: A Valuable Nugget.
<color="grey">Worth a pretty penny when recycled.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_PhotoOfHome:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: Yearning Photo. +15% climb speed. +20% walking speed when grounded.
<color="grey">A place you'd like to be. It's worth getting there, at all costs.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_Pouch:
<color=#FF8AFF>Inventory Upgrade: Pouch
<color="grey"> Adds a pouch into your inventory, where you can stack up to five of the same item type for the weight of one.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_CalmingBuddy:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: Calming Buddy. Slows time while looking in your bag. 
<color="grey">Relax, breathe in, breathe out. Take it all in.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_Helmet:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: Helmet. Reduced grip loss, increased damage and knockback resist. 
<color="grey">Worker tested, OSHA approved.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Trinket_ClimbingShoes:
<color=#FF8AFF>Trinket: Climbing Shoes. Reduces stamina drain while resting during a hang, and from climb-jumps. 
<color="grey">Made to ease any climb.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Cleaver:
<color=#72e0be>Minor Artifact: Cleaver
<color="grey">A hungry tool to help you devour your enemies. It wouldn't lie to you about what you are eating, would it?[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Beans_Periphery:
<color=#72e0be>Minor Artifact: Delta 0052
<color="grey">All the things you want, for a limited time.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_RhoStone:
<color=#72e0be>Minor Artifact: Rho Stone
<color="grey">Has the power to hold the Mass at bay, for a little while.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_BlinkEye:
<color=#72e0be>Minor Artifact: Blink Eye
<color="grey">Ripped from some poor soul.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_EntityScanner:
<color=white>Item: Entity Scanner
<color="grey">Scans for items and denizens.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Handgun:
<color=white>Item: Handgun
<color="grey">Drake Combat Solutions MD95 10mm Service Pistol.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_Cryogun:
<color=white>Item: Cryo-Gun
<color="grey">Experimental handhold-creation tool. Can be refilled at cryo stations.[ID]
ItemDescriptions.desc-Item_BarnacleHook:
<color=white>Lambda Artifact: Barnacle Hook
<color="grey">A young barnacle turned tool. Needs to be fed to regenerate stamina.[ID]
